chunks: Sa'd, from al-Husayn ibn 'Umar ibn Yazid, from Yunus ibn 'Abd al-Rahman, from 'Abd Allah ibn Muskan, who said:
I saw Aba 'Abd Allah عليه السلام give the adhan and the iqamah without separating between them by sitting.

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: A kunyah referring to Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq عليه السلام.
key_terms.أَذَّنَ: He gave the adhan, the call announcing the prayer.
key_terms.أَقَامَ: He gave the iqamah, the call marking the immediate commencement of salat.
key_terms.بِجُلُوسٍ: By sitting; here, sitting as a pause between the adhan and iqamah.
key_terms.يَفْصِلَ: To separate or place an interval between two things.

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to give the adhan and iqamah without sitting between them?
ai.summary: This hadith reports the practice of Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام in performing the adhan and iqamah consecutively without sitting between them. It is relevant to prayer rulings and the practical sunnah related to the call to prayer.
